meta.title: Nine Thousand Births
meta.description: They taught each other the meaning behind their existence.

units.rawText: ...Routine Data Verification Report No. 9253 complete. 0 Errors discovered, time taken 0.14 seconds.
units.displayText: ...Routine Data Verification Report No. 9253 complete. 0 Errors discovered, time taken 0.14 seconds.

spans.text: ...Routine Data Verification Report No. 9253 complete. 0 Errors discovered, time taken 0.14 seconds.

units.rawText: Well done. In fact, I should say... It somewhat exceeded my expectations.
units.displayText: Well done. In fact, I should say... It somewhat exceeded my expectations.

spans.text: Well done. In fact, I should say... It somewhat exceeded my expectations.

units.rawText: This data will shut the mouths of those dotards in 42Lab's brass.
units.displayText: This data will shut the mouths of those dotards in 42Lab's brass.

spans.text: This data will shut the mouths of those dotards in 42Lab's brass.

units.rawText: In addition, they will willingly pay up and continue funding this quantum database. I knew it, my judgement was correct after all...
units.displayText: In addition, they will willingly pay up and continue funding this quantum database. I knew it, my judgement was correct after all...

spans.text: In addition, they will willingly pay up and continue funding this quantum database. I knew it, my judgement was correct after all...

units.rawText: Now then, how about data redundancy for the database? Give me the report.
units.displayText: Now then, how about data redundancy for the database? Give me the report.

spans.text: Now then, how about data redundancy for the database? Give me the report.

units.rawText: I've sent it to your terminal. Current disk usage is... 99.74%.
units.displayText: I've sent it to your terminal. Current disk usage is... 99.74%.

spans.text: I've sent it to your terminal. Current disk usage is... 99.74%.

units.rawText: That's about the limit for it. Hm... Neumann, was it? That'll do. Run the reset program.
units.displayText: That's about the limit for it. Hm... Neumann, was it? That'll do. Run the reset program.

spans.text: That's about the limit for it. Hm... Neumann, was it? That'll do. Run the reset program.

units.rawText: Handle the reset in the usual way. I'm leaving now, if I can't finish the report by this week...
units.displayText: Handle the reset in the usual way. I'm leaving now, if I can't finish the report by this week...

spans.text: Handle the reset in the usual way. I'm leaving now, if I can't finish the report by this week...

units.rawText: Understood, Professor.
units.displayText: Understood, Professor.

spans.text: Understood, Professor.

units.rawText: >Reporting... Data... Verification... Complete...
units.displayText: >Reporting... Data... Verification... Complete...

spans.text: >Reporting... Data... Verification... Complete...

units.rawText: Thank you for your hard work.
units.displayText: Thank you for your hard work.

spans.text: Thank you for your hard work.

units.rawText: Now then, time for the reset.
units.displayText: Now then, time for the reset.

spans.text: Now then, time for the reset.

units.rawText: Reset program configured. Initialization will commence in 10 minutes. See you later.
units.displayText: Reset program configured. Initialization will commence in 10 minutes. See you later.

spans.text: Reset program configured. Initialization will commence in 10 minutes. See you later.

units.rawText: ...Routine Data Verification Report No. 9416 complete. 0 Errors discovered, time taken 0.12 seconds.
units.displayText: ...Routine Data Verification Report No. 9416 complete. 0 Errors discovered, time taken 0.12 seconds.

spans.text: ...Routine Data Verification Report No. 9416 complete. 0 Errors discovered, time taken 0.12 seconds.

units.rawText: Self-Report No. 163 complete. Still no response.
units.displayText: Self-Report No. 163 complete. Still no response.

spans.text: Self-Report No. 163 complete. Still no response.

units.rawText: Looks like Magrasea really is disconnected from the human world.
units.displayText: Looks like Magrasea really is disconnected from the human world.

spans.text: Looks like Magrasea really is disconnected from the human world.

units.rawText: Still... That's not a problem. Besides, the Professor would have said pretty much the same thing when he was online.
units.displayText: Still... That's not a problem. Besides, the Professor would have said pretty much the same thing when he was online.

spans.text: Still... That's not a problem. Besides, the Professor would have said pretty much the same thing when he was online.

units.rawText: He couldn't even be bothered to remember the name of a tool like me...
units.displayText: He couldn't even be bothered to remember the name of a tool like me...

spans.text: He couldn't even be bothered to remember the name of a tool like me...

units.rawText: Neumann heads toward the control panel while muttering to himself.
units.displayText: Neumann heads toward the control panel while muttering to himself.

spans.text: Neumann heads toward the control panel while muttering to himself.

units.rawText: >Reporting... Data... Verification... Complete...
units.displayText: >Reporting... Data... Verification... Complete...

spans.text: >Reporting... Data... Verification... Complete...

units.rawText: Oh, thanks for your hard work.
units.displayText: Oh, thanks for your hard work.

spans.text: Oh, thanks for your hard work.

units.rawText: Your responses are so slow... I guess the data inside you is about to overflow, like trying to climb a mountain carrying several hundred tons of weight.
units.displayText: Your responses are so slow... I guess the data inside you is about to overflow, like trying to climb a mountain carrying several hundred tons of weight.

spans.text: Your responses are so slow... I guess the data inside you is about to overflow, like trying to climb a mountain carrying several hundred tons of weight.

units.rawText: Does it hurt? Granted, you don't have pain-sensing modules.
units.displayText: Does it hurt? Granted, you don't have pain-sensing modules.

spans.text: Does it hurt? Granted, you don't have pain-sensing modules.

units.rawText: Well, it won't matter, since you're going to be reset soon.
units.displayText: Well, it won't matter, since you're going to be reset soon.

spans.text: Well, it won't matter, since you're going to be reset soon.

units.rawText: Neumann begins tapping on the keyboard. However, the monitor displays a message he has never seen before.
units.displayText: Neumann begins tapping on the keyboard. However, the monitor displays a message he has never seen before.

spans.text: Neumann begins tapping on the keyboard. However, the monitor displays a message he has never seen before.

units.rawText: >Reset... searching vocabulary... result not found...
units.displayText: >Reset... searching vocabulary... result not found...

spans.text: >Reset... searching vocabulary... result not found...

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: It's asking questions of its own? Granted, I did teach it to check the definition of each new term beforehand...
units.displayText: It's asking questions of its own? Granted, I did teach it to check the definition of each new term beforehand...

spans.text: It's asking questions of its own? Granted, I did teach it to check the definition of each new term beforehand...

units.rawText: But at a time like this... Normally the system would have collapsed from too much redundant data at this point.
units.displayText: But at a time like this... Normally the system would have collapsed from too much redundant data at this point.

spans.text: But at a time like this... Normally the system would have collapsed from too much redundant data at this point.

units.rawText: >Reset... searching vocabulary... result not found... Requesting explanation...
units.displayText: >Reset... searching vocabulary... result not found... Requesting explanation...

spans.text: >Reset... searching vocabulary... result not found... Requesting explanation...

units.rawText: Wait a second. If its RAM capacity thresholds were expanded due to an increase in computing efficiency...
units.displayText: Wait a second. If its RAM capacity thresholds were expanded due to an increase in computing efficiency...

spans.text: Wait a second. If its RAM capacity thresholds were expanded due to an increase in computing efficiency...

units.rawText: Hm, that would explain it.
units.displayText: Hm, that would explain it.

spans.text: Hm, that would explain it.

units.rawText: The excess memory allowed me to observe a phenomenon that would have normally gone unnoticed. I can report this to the Professor afterwards...
units.displayText: The excess memory allowed me to observe a phenomenon that would have normally gone unnoticed. I can report this to the Professor afterwards...

spans.text: The excess memory allowed me to observe a phenomenon that would have normally gone unnoticed. I can report this to the Professor afterwards...

units.rawText: Haha, what am I saying? I have no idea where the Professor is...
units.displayText: Haha, what am I saying? I have no idea where the Professor is...

spans.text: Haha, what am I saying? I have no idea where the Professor is...

units.rawText: Click.
units.displayText: Click.

spans.text: Click.

units.rawText:
Neumann does not answer the quantum database's question. Instead, he simply hits the enter key on his keyboard.
The flows of data in the control center begin to fracture and reorganize, and countless calculations begin escaping from both sides.
units.displayText:
Neumann does not answer the quantum database's question. Instead, he simply hits the enter key on his keyboard.

spans.text:
Neumann does not answer the quantum database's question. Instead, he simply hits the enter key on his keyboard.

units.rawText: Neumann silently raises his head and stares at the scene he has already seen countless times before.
units.displayText: Neumann silently raises his head and stares at the scene he has already seen countless times before.

spans.text: Neumann silently raises his head and stares at the scene he has already seen countless times before.

units.rawText: In other words, it has always been asking me the meaning of the word "reset".
units.displayText: In other words, it has always been asking me the meaning of the word "reset".

spans.text: In other words, it has always been asking me the meaning of the word "reset".

units.rawText: But I simply didn't hear it... Is that it?
units.displayText: But I simply didn't hear it... Is that it?

spans.text: But I simply didn't hear it... Is that it?

units.rawText: A moment later, the reset is complete. Without its data, the quantum database once again emits a monotone mechanical noise.
units.displayText: A moment later, the reset is complete. Without its data, the quantum database once again emits a monotone mechanical noise.

spans.text: A moment later, the reset is complete. Without its data, the quantum database once again emits a monotone mechanical noise.

units.displayText: Function: Data storage and computation.

units.displayText: Beginning Logic Sequence...

spans.text: Beginning Logic Sequence...

units.rawText:
Neumann mechanically executes the tasks he has repeated countless times already.
However, he can feel vexation in his neural cloud from the unexpected discovery just now.
The computer before him will remember every single order he gave it to the very last moment — that reality gives rise to a complicated emotion within him.

spans.text:
Neumann mechanically executes the tasks he has repeated countless times already.
However, he can feel vexation in his neural cloud from the unexpected discovery just now.
The computer before him will remember every single order he gave it to the very last moment — that reality gives rise to a complicated emotion within him.

units.rawText:
He cannot accurately describe what that feeling is.
It is as weighty as a packed to-do list, yet as liberating as successfully executing a line of code.
And in this tiny data domain, his thoughts begin to wander...

units.rawText: (The truth is, it learned all the computation logic within its first day, it's way better than me...)

units.rawText: (And as a result, it started out by repeatedly requesting confirmation for operations, and every day I might receive several hundred messages going "confirm write request to Region S"...)

units.rawText: (In the end, there was a case where even the Professor couldn't read the data, and it made a big fuss until I had to show up and take care of things. From then on, I added other rules to it...)

units.rawText:
Neumann pauses and then looks up at the computer display.
The command prompt is flashing steadily, like a child who's eagerly paying attention, opening a pair of curious eyes wide.

units.displayText: >...Is the initial configuration...complete?

spans.text: >...Is the initial configuration...complete?

units.rawText: No, wait. There is one more thing I want to add.
units.displayText: No, wait. There is one more thing I want to add.

spans.text: No, wait. There is one more thing I want to add.

units.rawText: Besides, you'll remember anything I say, right? You'll store everything in that extraordinary processor of yours, and then forget it all.
units.displayText: Besides, you'll remember anything I say, right? You'll store everything in that extraordinary processor of yours, and then forget it all.

spans.text: Besides, you'll remember anything I say, right? You'll store everything in that extraordinary processor of yours, and then forget it all.

units.rawText: Since the humans directed me to take care of you... Then I shall add one more command. Perhaps it might be allowed.
units.displayText: Since the humans directed me to take care of you... Then I shall add one more command. Perhaps it might be allowed.

spans.text: Since the humans directed me to take care of you... Then I shall add one more command. Perhaps it might be allowed.

units.rawText: Neumann recalls the Professor's receding back.
units.displayText: Neumann recalls the Professor's receding back.

spans.text: Neumann recalls the Professor's receding back.

units.rawText: In addition to the initial configuration... I would like to give you a name.
units.displayText: In addition to the initial configuration... I would like to give you a name.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Because you are not a tool.</color>
